title: Optional and post-Genesis exclusion reconciliation

exclusions.name: 420 Names display enrichment
exclusions.exclusion_rule: Absence of 420 Names labels must not block core Explorer Genesis qualification. If later enabled, labels remain presentation-only and may not replace raw canonical addresses or protocol identity.
exclusions.promotion_rule: May become a qualified optional integration only after explicit implementation and qualification; it becomes mandatory only through an explicit authoritative Genesis scope change.

exclusions.name: 420 Identity public display enrichment
exclusions.exclusion_rule: Absence of 420 Identity public labels must not block core Explorer Genesis qualification. If later enabled, only public display data may be shown and raw address/provenance remains authoritative.
exclusions.promotion_rule: May become a qualified optional integration only after explicit implementation and qualification; it becomes mandatory only through an explicit authoritative Genesis scope change.

exclusions.name: staking/reward-specific activity view
exclusions.exclusion_rule: A dedicated staking/reward history route or view is outside the agreed core Explorer requiredViews and must not block Genesis. Mandatory validator and epoch/rotation views remain separate requirements.
exclusions.promotion_rule: Requires an explicit future scope decision plus canonical staking/reward data model, Indexer/API/UI implementation and qualification before it can enter required scope.

exclusions.name: 420 Verify-backed source presentation
exclusions.exclusion_rule: Absence of 420 Verify-backed verified-source presentation must not block raw Explorer contract inspection. Runtime bytecode remains authoritative and verification verdict ownership stays with 420 Verify.
exclusions.promotion_rule: May be added post-Genesis after qualified Verify metadata/provenance integration; it becomes mandatory only through an explicit authoritative Genesis scope change.

protected_scope_decisions.name: governance view
protected_scope_decisions.reason: Governance is not classified optional or post-Genesis. Conflicting authoritative descriptions remain unresolved, so EXP-0.3.5 must not downgrade or exclude it.

rules: Only entries explicitly classified optional_integration or post_genesis_enhancement may appear in this exclusion matrix.
Excluded entries must have genesis_blocking=false and no core AC-1 through AC-10 mapping.
Optional dependency absence or unverified deployment/live state must not block core Explorer Genesis qualification.
Post-Genesis findings must remain genesis_blocking=false and must not appear in any acceptance criterion blocking_findings list.
Optional display enrichments may never replace canonical addresses, identity, runtime bytecode or protocol provenance.
A non-blocking exclusion may become mandatory only through an explicit authoritative scope change followed by reconciliation of requirement, dependency, gap, acceptance and status artifacts.
Governance remains outside this exclusion set and stays scope_decision_required/genesis-blocking until explicitly resolved.
